freshLocalStatus.message: Internet-enabled sandboxed commands are available after confirmation. Network access may reach local and private services. Runtime containment is checked at command startup.
freshLocalStatus.runtimeVerification: Version/resource checks precede selection; owner startup verifies namespaces and effective cgroup limits.
freshLocalStatus.disclosure: Trusted Development permits terminal internet access and may reach host-local, private LAN, VPN and local development services, including authenticated endpoints using credentials available to the command. Dependency lifecycle scripts have this same network authority. Filesystem and process restrictions remain, but do not prevent network-side effects. External IPv6 is unsupported; host loopback aliases remain transport-restricted. Workspace Write commands run autonomously inside the sandbox. This applies to all Workspace Write sessions.
